name: Joomla
description_en:
Joomla is a self-hosted PHP content management system for organizing articles, categories, menus, templates and extensions. It combines public content delivery with user groups, viewing access levels and action permissions. Its software is free under GNU GPL version2 or later; hosting, site implementation and commercial extensions remain separate decisions.

Its publishing model deserves attention: publication dates, featured placement, access visibility and workflow stages are different controls. A transition can advance even when its publishing action fails for lack of permission. Teams should verify the public result and actual roles rather than equating a completed editorial step with a live page.
description_zh:
Joomla 是自托管 PHP 内容管理系统，用于组织文章、分类、菜单、模板和扩展，将公共内容交付与用户组、查看访问级别及操作权限结合。软件按 GNU GPL第2版或后续版本免费提供；托管、建站实施及商业扩展另行选择。

其发布模型需仔细理解：发布日期、精选展示、可见范围及工作流阶段是不同控制。工作流可能已推进，但其中发布动作因权限不足失败；团队应检查公开结果和实际角色，不能将编辑步骤完成等同页面上线。

core_features.explanation_en: Organize content into categories, route it through menus and control presentation with templates and overrides.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将内容组织为分类、通过菜单关联，并以模板和覆盖机制控制展示。

core_features.explanation_en: User groups and access levels determine who can see objects, while global/component/item permissions control actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用户组和访问级别控制对象可见性，全局/组件/条目权限控制操作。

core_features.name_zh: 定时文章及可配置工作流
core_features.explanation_en: Publishing windows and featured windows are independent; workflows add stages/transitions with role-dependent actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 发布窗口和精选窗口独立，工作流增加带角色相关操作的阶段及转换。

pricing.summary_en: Free GPL CMS software. Hosting, domain, implementation, maintenance and selected commercial extensions/templates/support are separate; no numeric total verified.
pricing.summary_zh: GPL CMS 软件免费；主机、域名、实施、维护及所选商业扩展/模板/支持另计，未核实数字总成本。

sections.title_en: Model an information site before installing extensions
sections.title_zh: 先设计信息站结构，再安装扩展
sections.en:
For an association site, use categories for news and member guidance, articles for individual notices and menu items for the routes readers need. Choose a template and test its layouts with real text and media before buying additional extensions. The core features page documents nested categories, WYSIWYG/frontend editing, media, content versions, custom fields, menus, redirects and language associations. Its traffic/share and security superlatives are project marketing, not measurements made here.

Joomla CMS and Joomla Framework are separate projects: the Framework can build PHP web/command-line applications without installing the CMS. Do not attribute a custom Framework application or a third-party extension to the default CMS feature set.
sections.zh:
例如协会站可用分类划分新闻和会员指南、文章承载通知、菜单条目建立读者需要的路径。购买扩展前，先选择模板并以实际文字及媒体测试布局。核心功能页列嵌套分类、所见即所得/前台编辑、媒体、内容版本、自定义字段、菜单、重定向及语言关联；其流量/份额和安全最高级描述来自项目宣传，本次未测量。

Joomla CMS 与 Joomla Framework 是独立项目，后者可在不安装 CMS 时构建 PHP 网页/命令行应用。不能将定制 Framework 应用或第三方扩展算作默认 CMS 功能。

sections.title_en: Separate who can see content from who can edit it
sections.title_zh: 区分谁能查看与谁能编辑
sections.en:
The ACL guide separates viewing Access Levels from Action Permissions. An article or module marked Registered is intended for logged-in users, while a menu restricted to Super Users is visible only to that level. Hiding a menu is therefore a separate setting from restricting the article itself. Action permissions are set globally and at component/item scopes, with inherited settings requiring careful inspection.

Default Author users can create and edit their own articles on the site; Editor/Publisher add capabilities, whereas administrator login is a different permission. For a member notice pilot, test the article URL as a guest and member, and try editing/publishing as each assigned role. A group name or a restricted menu alone is not an access-control acceptance test.
sections.zh:
ACL 指南区分查看访问级别与操作权限。文章或模块标为 Registered 面向已登录用户，菜单若限制为 Super Users 则只有相应级别可见；隐藏菜单与限制文章本身是不同设置。操作权限分全局、组件和条目范围，继承结果需逐项检查。

默认 Author 可在前台创建及编辑自己的文章，Editor/Publisher 增加能力，而后台登录另有权限。会员通知试点应以访客及会员直接访问文章 URL，再以各角色尝试编辑/发布。组名或受限菜单本身不构成访问控制验收。

sections.title_en: Use publication and featured windows deliberately
sections.title_zh: 明确使用发布窗口和精选窗口
sections.en:
The publishing guide says a scheduled article must have Status set to Published, with Start Publishing delayed to a future time. Before that it is Pending; after Finish Publishing it is Expired, even though the underlying status remains Published. The date constraints determine public availability.

Start/End Featured control only featured layouts: ending featured placement can leave the article available in a blog or single-article layout. A practical test is a temporary announcement with separate public and featured windows. Inspect the direct page, category view and featured view around the boundary, including the deployment timezone. These are documented semantics and proposed checks, not an executed scheduling test.
sections.zh:
发布指南称定时文章需将 Status 设为 Published，并将 Start Publishing 设为未来时间；开始前为 Pending，Finish Publishing 后为 Expired，底层状态仍可为 Published，由日期限制决定公开可用性。

Start/End Featured 只控制精选布局，结束精选后，文章仍可能在博客或单文章布局可访问。可用临时公告设置不同公开及精选窗口，在边界前后检查直达页、分类页及精选页，并核对部署时区。上述为文档语义及建议检查，未执行定时测试。

sections.title_en: Verify the content state after a workflow transition
sections.title_zh: 工作流转换后核对内容状态
sections.en:
Workflows are enabled in Articles Options and assigned by category. They add stages and transitions alongside the independent static article states; transition permissions and workflow plugins determine the resulting actions and notifications.

The guide explicitly warns that Workflow Publishing can fail when the user cannot change state while the requested transition still succeeds. A review-stage advance must therefore be checked against the actual published state and visible result. With workflows enabled, workflow-managed fields such as state/featured are excluded from versioning to avoid permission conflicts. For a newsletter workflow, assign author/reviewer/publisher roles, test a rejection and a permission failure, and confirm that only the intended account makes the notice public.
sections.zh:
在 Articles Options 启用工作流，并按分类指定。工作流在独立的文章静态状态之外增加阶段及转换，转换权限和工作流插件决定实际动作与通知。

指南明确提醒：用户无权改变状态时，Workflow Publishing 可失败，而请求的转换仍成功。因此推进审稿阶段后仍需核对实际发布状态及公开结果。启用工作流时，state/featured 等工作流管理字段不进入版本记录，以免权限冲突。通讯工作流可分作者/审阅/发布角色，测试退回和权限失败，确认只有预期账户公开通知。

sections.title_en: Match the installation and upgrade guidance to the release
sections.title_zh: 让安装和升级指引匹配版本
sections.en:
The installer guide requires a prepared PHP hosting environment and database, uploading/extracting the package, then supplying site, superuser and database details through the web installer. It describes PHP upload/memory limits and warns that smaller upload allowances can prevent larger extensions from installing. Database credentials and Joomla administrator credentials are distinct. Changing connection settings without the corresponding database can break the installation.

Source versions are uneven: the homepage announces Joomla6.2, the developer manual snapshot labels6.1 Current/6.2 Upcoming, and the installation article still uses5.x examples. This record does not turn those examples into Joomla6.2 runtime minimums. Use the intended release requirements and extension/template compatibility checks, stage upgrades, and prove a database/files restore. The legacy docs.joomla.org read returned403 and was not bypassed; the linked current guide/manual were readable.
sections.zh:
安装指南要求先备好 PHP 主机及数据库，上传/解压安装包，再通过网页安装器填写站点、超级用户及数据库信息；它描述 PHP 上传/内存限制，并提醒上传额度较小会令较大扩展安装失败。数据库账户与 Joomla 管理账户不同，没有对应数据库时改变连接设置可能破坏安装。

来源版本并不一致：首页宣布 Joomla6.2，开发手册快照标6.1为当前、6.2为即将推出，安装文章仍使用5.x示例。本档案不将示例变成 Joomla6.2运行最低要求。需按目标版本核对运行环境及扩展/模板兼容，暂存升级并验证数据库/文件恢复。旧 docs.joomla.org 读取返回403，未绕过；官网链接的当前指南/手册可读。

sections.title_en: Budget for operation while preserving GPL obligations
sections.title_zh: 预算运营成本，并保留 GPL 义务
sections.en:
The project states that Joomla is free to use under GPL and the license FAQ identifies GNU GPLv2 or later. Commercial use and charging for distribution are allowed; “commercial” does not mean “proprietary.” The FAQ distinguishes removing copyright from generated output from retaining notices in source. It presents the project’s position that most extensions derive from Joomla, while template non-code assets can have separate terms. These are source descriptions, not individualized legal advice.

Free CMS software does not pay for hosting, a domain, implementation, maintenance or a selected paid extension/template/support contract. No numeric total or hosting renewal price was verified. Suitable teams can manage a self-hosted PHP application and its editorial permissions; teams requiring all operations handled should obtain an explicit managed-service scope and recovery commitment.
sections.zh:
项目声明 Joomla 按 GPL 免费使用，许可 FAQ 标为 GNU GPLv2 或后续版本，允许商业使用及收费分发，“商业”不等于“专有”。FAQ 区分从生成输出删除版权与在源码保留声明，并表达项目方关于多数扩展为衍生作品的立场，模板非代码资产则可有独立条款。此处为来源概括，不是个别法律意见。

免费 CMS 不承担主机、域名、实施、维护或所选付费扩展/模板/支持合同费用，本次未核实数字总成本或主机续费价。能管理自托管 PHP 应用及编辑权限的团队可考虑；需要全包运营则应取得明确托管服务范围及恢复承诺。
